references.text: The Lord had just told Balaam not to go with the men or curse the people, which Balaam now refers to when he says that the Lord refuses to let him go.
Balaam sends back the same officials that Balak had sent to him with a fee for divination.
The officials return to Balak and tell what Balaam said, which is the direct continuation of this event.
Balaam later confirms that he cannot go beyond the Lord's command, reflecting his attitude here.
Moses recounts how the Lord refused to listen to Balaam and did not allow him to curse Israel.
